Our story

A family story,
stitched together.

Meet Reine, Laure & Yara Abi Hanna, the hands behind Triple Threads.

Meet the hands behind the threads

A thread
worth following.

Triple Threads is a family project led by Reine Abi Hanna with her daughters Laure and Yara. Their craft carries forward skills Reine learned from her mother, bringing crochet, embroidery and beading into a new family chapter.

Based in Sahel Aalma, Jounieh, the makers create across a varied world of accessories and home pieces. This collection focuses on the clutches, pouches and motif pieces pictured in their public portfolio.

Made in Sahel Aalma, Jounieh, Lebanon.

Visits are by appointment. Contact the makers before coming.
